# Experimental AR9380 native Wi-Fi

The MAC revision encoding is checked against the [upstream register definitions](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/reg.h):
2.2 is register revision 3; register revision 2 is 2.0/2.1 and is declined
because this port includes the 2.2 programming tables.

Exact initial profile: PCI `168c:0030`, PCIe AR9380 MAC revision 2.2.
Other silicon (including AR9485), noncontiguous chain masks, malformed board
data, unsupported gain tables and failed calibration publish no interface.
This uses the shared open/WPA2-PSK station, software CCMP, passive channels
1-11 and legacy b/g rates on 2.4 GHz. No HT, 5 GHz, aggregation, PAPRD,
Bluetooth coexistence, suspend/resume or high-throughput claim.

Hardware routines are adapted from the pinned OpenBSD ISC sources listed
in [README.md](README.md), with separate native register/DMA/station code in
`net/ar9380.c`. No BSD kernel, DMA or networking subsystem is imported.
The 2009, 2010 and 2011 notices are retained and installed at
`/usr/share/licenses/ar9380/NOTICES`. No external radio firmware is needed.

## Board data and calibration

The decoder distinguishes physical EEPROM capacity (512/1024/4096 bytes)
and OTP capacity (512/1024 bytes)
from the reconstructed 1088-byte board structure. It supports uncompressed
images and checksum-checked block patches against the pinned templates,
including patches against a previously restored image. Unknown compression,
missing base templates, truncated/oversized patches and invalid checksums fail
before DMA is enabled. EEPROM/OTP byte order works at either address parity.
Nothing writes EEPROM, OTP or flash.

Usable frequency tables, factory MAC, contiguous 1/3/7 chain masks, supported
gain tables and legacy CTL coverage are validated. Trailing unused frequency
entries are excluded from interpolation. The minimum applicable board CTL
ceiling and interpolated board target can lower the initial 10 dBm ceiling;
positive antenna gain and active-chain power reductions lower it further.
This is a conservative software profile, not a measured RF/regulatory guarantee.

TX IQ arithmetic uses wide intermediates and independently packed signed
coefficients. Calibration errors propagate, and original board chain masks
are restored on success and failure. Initial AGC/TX IQ and periodic RX IQ,
noise-floor and board temperature compensation remain bounded. Full-width
negative hardware samples cannot overflow an absolute-value operation.

## DMA and failure behavior

RX uses separate hardware low/high-priority pointer FIFOs, 64/16 private
2304-byte buffers and inline 48-byte statuses. The driver validates descriptor
identity, packet status, lengths, header padding and fragmented buffer chains
before delivering FCS-stripped packets. An impossible FIFO completion order
stops the card instead of guessing DMA ownership.

TX uses a bounded 16-packet software queue, one hardware packet at a time,
128-byte descriptors with pointer checksum and a separate 64-entry completion
ring. Completion vendor, queue and generation must match the outstanding
packet before its buffer is reused. Full queues return backpressure.
Corrupt completions, removal, RF kill or a two-second TX stall stop bus
mastering and clear only that station's keys/carrier. DMA storage stays resident.
The initial fatal-error recovery path requires reboot.

Polling leaves MSI/MSI-X/INTx and device interrupts disabled. Hardware crypto
and hardware sequence-number assignment are disabled.

## Validation and limits

`python3 tools/test_ar9380.py --sanitize` and `--32` execute the actual HAL,
frontend and shared WPA2 station against an independent register/EEPROM/DMA
model and cryptographic packet vectors. They cover scan/authentication/
association, M1-M4, encrypted unicast/group data, replay rejection, FIFO/ring
wrap, pending DMA ownership, bad completions and initialization failures,
OTP and raw/compressed EEPROM, chain restoration and board power ceilings.
There are 1000 checksum-valid board-data mutations, 20000 RX mutations and
20000 compressed-patch/IQ mutations, including a known IQ reference case.

Host models and OS boot/network regressions do not validate real RF,
sensitivity, regulatory interoperability or throughput. No physical AR9380
was available. This remains experimental until physical testing.
